title: Inspect generated list boundary before validator execution
failure_signature: A generated Python list closes on the same physical line as a following branch.
trigger_preconditions: A generated validator fails compilation at a list-to-branch boundary.
candidate_workaround: Insert one exact newline at the list boundary, recompile, and then run the unchanged bounded selection.
recurrence_guard: Compile generated Python before execution and inspect list-to-control-flow boundaries after slice replacement.
rollback: Stop before execution, retain the syntax failure, and leave external and sibling state unchanged.
scope_boundary: Workflow recovery only; no scientific, professional, production, authority, or independent-reproduction credit.
